name: Union Hall
notes: StartupCincy Week hub and daily check-in. SCW FAQ: "All attendees should check in each day at Union Hall (1311 Vine Street) before heading to sessions or events at other locations." Cintrifuse: "Sitting at the center of Cincinnati’s vibrant and historic Over-the-Rhine district, Union Hall serves as the bustling hub of our startup ecosystem. With 38,000 square feet of private offices, coworking, and event space ..." Event rooms listed by Cintrifuse: Beer Hall (seats up to 200), Homeroom, conference rooms (6–10 people); members also get a private rooftop. Coworking day pass: "$25 / day / person". Soapbox (2026-09-15): the week "still uses Union Hall as a central gathering place, but its footprint has expanded into multiple blocks in Over-the-Rhine." Same id as the scw-agenda slice. Coordinates: Nominatim "Union Hall, 1311, Vine Street, Vine Street Business District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States".

name: Beer Hall at Union Hall
notes: A room inside Union Hall (parent venue: union-hall), not a separate building. Cintrifuse: "Perfect for a full or half day seminar, our Beer Hall seats up to 200 guests. The space includes a projector and screen, accommodating large presentations." 2026 agenda: "SUCW 2026 Kickoff!" (Oct 5, "Join us LIVE! from Beer Hall at Union Hall") and "SUCW Student Day Kickoff!" (Oct 8, "Union Hall - Beer Hall").

name: Somerhaus
notes: Startup Clubhouse host in 2025. Leftover (hidden) 2025 text on startupcincyweek.com: "A pop-up HQ for startup operators during StartupCincy Week. Hosted at Somerhaus, it’s part coworking lounge, part skills lab, part community hub—built to connect and recharge founders, early employees, and builders at every stage." No 2026 source names the Clubhouse location, so Somerhaus is NOT confirmed for 2026. Address and phone ((513) 902-1415) from somerhaus.space; its contact page notes: "Republic Street is permit parking only (visitors may be ticketed or towed)". about 110 m straight-line from Union Hall (computed from coordinates). Coordinates: Nominatim "1415, Republic Street, Over-the-Rhine Historic District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States".
